'''2007 New York State Championship Bill Kafer LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
